issue.body:
Split from #203 after Gemini architecture review returned split_required.

Scope:
- Seal raw certificate, lease, and fencing store access behind typed authority access tokens.
- Add governed authority store adapter facade and published receipt view fields.
- Update test fixtures that directly exercise raw stores to use explicit test fixture access tokens.

Non-goals:
- Do not complete governed transport integration.
- Do not complete migration/recovery/peripheral runtime caller migration.
- Do not perform closeout/background lifecycle bookkeeping.

Validation target:
- cargo check --manifest-path adl-runtime/Cargo.toml
- cargo test --manifest-path adl-runtime/Cargo.toml --test distributed_identity_lease_authority -- --nocapture --test-threads=1
- cargo clippy --manifest-path adl-runtime/Cargo.toml --test distributed_identity_lease_authority -- -D warnings
- compile-only checks for raw fixture fallout as needed.

Issue graph: split_from #203; part_of #142.
